title: Handle missing values honestly
summary: A missing value means a measurement is absent. It does not mean zero. Keep track of what you leave out of a calculation.
introduction: A missing value means a measurement is absent. It does not mean zero. Keep track of what you leave out of a calculation. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: A missing value means a measurement is absent. It does not mean zero. Keep track of what you leave out of a calculation.

minutes = [10, None, 20]
known = [value for value in minutes if value is not None]
print(sum(known) / len(known), len(known))
